headline: Forward Thinking Engineer
summary: Forward Thinking Engineer. Focus: integrate AI, custom-built around each company's tools, workflows and needs; shadow employees, build agents and tools for any digital task, teach, scale. Goal: lower costs, no cuts to people. Independent, AI-assisted developer.

projects.short: Built 10 review tools where every finding shows its source and a person decides; optional AI drafts with citations.

projects.name: dotz - AI Coding Agent Dashboard
bullets: Built a desktop app that runs and supervises AI coding agents, with model choice and safe cleanup.
Made failures clear instead of silent. Core tests pass on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Sessions and transcripts survive restarts. Context summaries use the agent service; provider failures keep saved settings and show a clear error.
projects.short: Connected saved agent profiles and local AI models to a coding-agent app, with sessions that survive restarts.

Added safeguards so tests never peek at future data, plus records of rejected ideas for review.
